title: Hacienda Leo 3 Bedroom Villa with Pool
description: Monthly pricing available - type in your dates for pricingThis Spanish Style Villa is situated in a quiet dead end road with beautiful views of the Ocean and Valley. Only a few minutes away from Sandy beaches and restaurants as well as 8 minutes to Rincon and less then that to grocery stores, a pharmacy and a bakery. Enjoy jumping in our spacious pool and dine outdoors on our large covered terrace.The spaceMonthly/ long term rentals preferred with 60% off regular price.We provide:-Modern AC units in all bedrooms- Comfortable memory foam mattresses - A fresh bath towel for each guest - Swimming pool with water fountain and beautiful illumination at night- A large dining table for your family and friends (can seat up to 12 comfortably - the table is on our covered terrace but can also be moved inside if so desired) - TV in the living room (Connect to your Netflix or Hulu account to enjoy movies)- Internet- A fully equipped kitchen with gas stove and oven. - Microwave- Coffee maker- Quality blender for smoothies and mixed drinks- Bluetooth speakerWhat we do not provide at this time:- Beach towels, beach chairs, umbrellas etc- Cable Television- Entertainment subscriptions such as Netflix, Hulu, Apple TV etc. - No Access to a washer and dryer (if stay is longer then 4 days access can be given)IMPORTANT:Puerto Rico can occasionally experience power and water outages. They are beyond our control. We provide a backup generator that can run from 6 pm to 7 am and will need to be turned off during the day. We also provide backup water (cool only-not heated) - we have a 400 gallon cistern that gravity feeds the house. The pressure will be significantly lower but you will have water in the house. Please, only book if you are willing to accept the above stated for the rare power and water outages that we are experiencing. ———- No outside guests allowed - Absolutely no parties allowed. - if bodily fluids are found on any of the furniture or on the beds etc. then an extra $500-$1000 charge may be added for additional cleaning. - if you show up with more than the allowed guests then your reservation may be canceled immediately/on arrival

description: Just a 5 minute drive from Sandy Beach, Domes, and other beautiful places to visit on the West side of PR, this unit is the perfect spot for your home base. With a tropical pool, and garden, Gypsea is perfect for surfers, snorkelers, and ocean lovers. Our satellite internet, backup water system and solar system ensures your comfort. Gypsea is a small 1 bedroom, 1 bath unit. The pool and garden are shared with the other units on property. Follow us @2casitas to see moreThe spaceGypsea is a small one-bedroom, one-bath apartment with kitchenette. Ideal for solo travelers or couples looking for a comfortable place between surf sessions, snorkel adventures, or paddleboard mornings.Tucked into a four-unit property, Gypsea is a small unit with a view to our tropical garden and pool. This unit has a small parking spot. For reference a Ford Bronco or Hyundai Kona fit perfectly. If your vehicle is too large, we can show you where there is street parking, a short walk from the property. Residential area. We are on a beach access road. No smoking anywhere inside or outside on the property.Guest accessWelcome to our little piece of paradise. We have a shared pool and tropical garden with beautiful plants and fruit trees. This is a four unit property. Each unit has a separate entrance and this unit has a separate parking spot. The parking spot is not covered, as mentioned in one of our reviews.Other things to noteThis property is in a residential area. We are off of the famous Route 413 , affectionately called " the Road to Happiness". Our property was built by a family many years ago and is now run by our family. Our property is solar-powered, connected to the grid, equipped with satellite internet and a backup water system ensuring amenities. We run on solar as much as possible. No smoking inside the property; Please do not litter. Don’t use glass or ceramic by the pool. You may be charged for items broken, lost or stained during your stay. Please take care of our place.We provide toilet paper, shampoo and conditioner as a starter pack. Depending on the length of your stay, you may need to purchase additional supplies. We provide umbrellas; we do not provide beach chairs.The pool does not have light at night. The animals are attracted by the light.
amenities: Shared outdoor pool - available all year, open specific hours

title: Bright, Tropical Vibes -Wooden Casita in Rincon
description: Take it easy at this unique and tranquil getaway, located in the heart of Puntas Rincon. The Casita boasts some amazing ocean views from it's multi-level decks. Inside, you'll find cathedral ceilings, allowing for lots of air flow and space. The kitchen is fully equipped to cook an awesome meal. There is one bedroom with an A/C Unit, and a separate cozy space with a futon. Large bathroom and living room make the space extra comfortable. Perfect for a small family or small group of friends!The spaceOwned by one of Rincon's Greatest Local's! This Tropical Wooden Casita is a home filled with so much love and uniqueness. Purchased in 1997, the owner has continued to expand upon the home and make improvements. He does live in the home during the high season (Approx. late November-April). The home is fully equipped to be lived in comfortably long term. It's truly a vibe, and such an authentic space to stay at while in Rincon. There is a 600 gallon back up water cistern and small gas powered generator. Private parking for two cars on site. The neighborhood is extremely quiet and you will feel very secluded and surrounded by ocean and jungle views while inside the home.Guest accessGuest may access the entire home, with the exception of the upstairs loft, which used as storage for the owner. Surfboards not available for use. Please inquire about renting boards from Road 2 Happiness.Other things to noteThe home is primarily managed by Sooz, the Property Manager. James is the owner of the house. The team has been working together since 2015. The Casita is Jame's personal home when he is on the island during the High Season. Sooz is also his close neighbor, and her rental house, The Babanees, is two doors up! Her management portfolio also includes Jame's investment property, Casa Pina, which is also located in Puntas. You may have come across these listings in your search :) Sooz is also off island during the High Season, but has been managing properties in Rincon since 2015. They work with a fantastic Family-Owned Maintenance Company, who also resides in the Puntas area. We are so proud of the work this team has been doing for us since 2015. We have weathered storms together, most notably, Hurricane Maria. Our Maintenance Team is the Best in Class, and prides itself on speed, efficiency, and safety. They are on the island, and available to assist always! The home does have a generator, water cistern laundry, Wifi, and TV with a Firestick to stream.
